posts.subject: Monitor nie działa przez USB-C - DP, Legion Pro 5 Gen 8 16IRX8
posts.author: bartek54761
posts.message_html:
Hi, 
I wanted to connect an external monitor (legion y27qf 30) to the laptop (Legion Pro 5 Gen 8 16IRX8) using a USB-C -> DP cable, however the laptop does not detect the monitor. The monitor detects that a Display Port cable is connected and after connecting to the laptop the monitor reacts (and the laptop reacts to e.g. turning off the monitor), but it displays nothing and goes into Standby Mode. The monitor is not detected in Windows settings. It works without any problem via HDMI.

The BIOS and all drivers are up to date.

I tried doing a reset by holding down the power button with the computer turned off and all devices disconnected, and I also changed the power settings related to USB selective suspend, but without success.

The cable is new, so I assume it is working.

What could be the solution to my problem?

posts.subject: Re:Monitor does not work via USB-C - DP, Legion Pro 5 Gen 8 16IRX8
posts.author: Hassen_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi @guest57461,

Thanks for the detailed info. Since HDMI works, the issue is likely related to DisplayPort Alt Mode over USB‑C (port capability, cable compatibility, or configuration). Please try the following:

1) Verify the correct USB‑C port - On the Legion Pro 5 Gen 8, not all USB‑C ports may carry video. Use the USB‑C port that has a DisplayPort (DP) icon next to it. If your unit has multiple USB‑C ports, test each one. - You can confirm your exact sub‑model’s port specs in PSREF: Lenovo Product Specifications Reference (PSREF).

2) Cable/adapter checks - Ensure the USB‑C → DP cable explicitly supports DP Alt Mode (DP 1.2/1.4). If possible, test with another known‑good USB‑C → DP cable, or use a USB‑C → DP adapter + DP cable to isolate the cable from the adapter function. - Connect directly (no hubs/docks in between). Plug into the monitor’s DP input firmly.

3) Monitor settings - Manually set the monitor input to DisplayPort (disable auto input if available). - In the monitor OSD, try setting DP version to 1.2 (some handshakes fail on 1.4) and disable Deep Sleep/Power Saving. Then power‑cycle the monitor. - Start with a conservative mode like 2560×1440 @ 60 Hz, then increase refresh rate later.

4) Graphics/driver configuration - Run updates in Lenovo Vantage → System Update for chipset, graphics, and USB/Thunderbolt drivers: Lenovo Vantage. - Update GPU drivers (NVIDIA and Intel, if applicable) from Lenovo Support. - If your system uses a MUX/Hybrid mode: - In Lenovo Vantage (or BIOS), set graphics to Hybrid and reboot. USB‑C DP is often routed through the iGPU; Discrete‑only mode can affect USB‑C display output on some configs. If already Hybrid, briefly test Discrete and reboot to compare. - In Windows, press Win+P → Extend, then go to Settings → Display → Detect. Also check Advanced display settings for the external screen when connected.

5) Additional steps - Shut down the laptop, connect the USB‑C → DP to the monitor, then power on the monitor first, followed by the laptop. - Test with another DP monitor if available, to rule out monitor‑side DP port issues.

If none of the above helps, there may be a hardware issue with the USB‑C video path. In that case, please contact us so we can assist with deeper diagnostics or service: - Contact Support: https://support.lenovo.com/contact-us - Create a Service Request: https://support.lenovo.com/servicerequest - Authorized Service Centers: https://support.lenovo.com/lenovo-service-provider/

Feel free to share which USB‑C port you used (side/rear and any icons), your current graphics mode (Hybrid/Discrete), and the exact cable model—this will help narrow things down.

Best regards, Hassen_Lenovo

topic_info.subject: Monitor nie działa przez USB-C - DP, Legion Pro 5 Gen 8 16IRX8
topic_info.message:
Cześć, 
Chciałem podłączyć zewnętrzny monitor (legion y27qf 30) do laptopa (Legion Pro 5 Gen 8 16IRX8) poprzez kabel USB-C -> DP, jednak laptop nie wykrywa monitora. Monitor wykrywa, że jest podłączony kabel Display Port i po podłączeniu do laptopa monitor reaguje (oraz laptop reaguje na np. zgaszenie monitora), ale nic nie wyświetla i przechodzi w Standby Mode. Monitor nie jest wykrywany w ustawieniach Windows. Bez problemu działa poprzez HDMI.

BIOS oraz wszystkie sterowniki są aktualne.

Próbowałem robić reset poprzez przytrzymanie przycisku włączania przy wyłączonym komputerze i odpiętych wszystkich urządzeniach oraz zmieniałem ustawienia zasilania dot. selektywnego wstrzymania USB, ale bez skutku.

Kabel jest nowy, więc zakładam, że jest sprawny.

Jakie może być rozwiązanie mojego problemu?
